taxonConvention.rationale: QualiaDB engine interop ID is the GBIF backbone taxon key (u64) — see crates/qualia-core-db/src/domains/geospatial/adapters/gbif_adapter.rs and audio/bioacoustics.rs::taxon_id. Scientific-name strings are display/lookup convenience only; they are NOT identity (homonyms, synonyms, rank moves).

ontologyBindings.note: dwc:Taxon / dwc:scientificName / dwc:taxonID terms apply at pack-compile time; auNSL covers flora nomenclature — fauna binding rides GBIF backbone until an AFD source is registered (G51).

taxonConvention.rankHonesty: taxon.rank reports the GBIF backbone rank verbatim, including backbone quirks — see the snake entry. Do not silently 'fix' ranks; record the backbone value and a note.
